R-DOC-01.title: Required document missing
R-DOC-01.next_step: ask the college for the missing {missing}

R-READ-01.title: Document could not be read
R-READ-01.next_step: ask for a clear copy of {document}
R-READ-01.fix: Upload a clear, original PDF of {document} instead of a photo or a faint scan.

R-SRC-01.title: Certificate signature is not genuine
R-SRC-01.plain: The QR code on {document} does not carry the issuer's genuine signature.
R-SRC-01.college: The QR code on your Fire NOC could not be verified with the issuing authority.
R-SRC-01.next_step: confirm the NOC directly with the fire department
R-SRC-01.fix: Submit the Fire NOC exactly as the fire department issued it.

R-SRC-02.title: Certificate not found or revoked at the issuer
R-SRC-02.plain: The fire department has no valid record of certificate {ref}.
R-SRC-02.college: Certificate {ref} could not be confirmed with the issuing authority.
R-SRC-02.next_step: confirm certificate {ref} with the fire department
R-SRC-02.fix: Submit a Fire NOC the fire department can confirm, or ask them to correct their record.

R-SRC-03.title: Printed text does not match the issuer's QR data
R-SRC-03.plain: {field} is printed as {printed}, but the issuer-signed QR says {issuer_signed}.
R-SRC-03.college: The {field} printed on your Fire NOC does not match the issuer's signed record.
R-SRC-03.next_step: treat the printed {field} as altered and ask the issuer for the original
R-SRC-03.fix: Submit the original Fire NOC as issued, without changes.

R-SRC-04.title: No issuer QR code, could not verify at source
R-SRC-04.plain: The Fire NOC has no readable issuer QR code, so it could not be checked at source.
R-SRC-04.next_step: verify the NOC with the fire department by phone or letter
R-SRC-04.fix: Ask the fire department for a copy of the NOC with a readable QR code.

R-DOC-02.title: Fire NOC expires before the academic year starts
R-DOC-02.plain: Fire NOC expires on {valid_until}, before the academic year starts on {academic_year_start}.
R-DOC-02.next_step: ask the college for a renewed Fire NOC
R-DOC-02.fix: Your Fire NOC expires on {valid_until}. Renew it so it is valid beyond {academic_year_start}, then apply.

R-LOGIC-01.title: Issued on a holiday or Sunday
R-LOGIC-01.plain: Fire NOC is dated {issued_on}, which was {holiday}.
R-LOGIC-01.college: The issue date on your Fire NOC needs to be confirmed with the issuing office.
R-LOGIC-01.next_step: ask the fire department to confirm the issue date
R-LOGIC-01.fix: Ask the fire department to confirm the issue date of your NOC.

R-LOGIC-02.title: Signer was not in post on the issue date
R-LOGIC-02.plain: {signer} signed on {signed_on}, but held the post only from {in_post}.
R-LOGIC-02.college: The officer who signed your Fire NOC could not be confirmed for that date.
R-LOGIC-02.next_step: confirm the signing officer with the fire department
R-LOGIC-02.fix: Ask the fire department to confirm who signed your NOC.

R-FACT-01.title: Land record differs from verified facts
R-FACT-01.plain: Land survey number changed from the verified {verified} to {uploaded}.
R-FACT-01.college: The land survey number differs from the record verified in an earlier cycle.
R-FACT-01.next_step: ask for the registered deed and check it with the Sub-Registrar
R-FACT-01.fix: Submit the registered deed and explain any change in the land record.

R-XINST-01.title: Teacher also listed full-time at another institution
R-XINST-01.college: {teacher} is also listed by another institution; confirm their status.
R-XINST-01.next_step: ask for {teacher}'s appointment order and salary records
R-XINST-01.fix: {teacher} is also listed by another institution. Confirm their status; a teacher can be full-time at one institution only.

R-SMS-01.title: Teacher replied NO: does not work here
R-SMS-01.plain: {teacher} replied NO: does not work here.
R-SMS-01.college: {teacher} has told AICTE that they do not work at your institution.
R-SMS-01.fix: Remove {teacher} from your faculty list or submit proof of employment.

R-NORM-01.title: Faculty below the norm after removing duplicates
R-NORM-01.plain: Faculty is below the norm: {required} needed for this intake, {counted} counted.
R-NORM-01.next_step: ask the college to appoint the missing faculty or reduce intake
R-NORM-01.fix: You need {required} full-time faculty for this intake and {counted} can be counted. Appoint more faculty or reduce the intake.

R-IMG-01.title: Lab photo matches another institution's photo
R-IMG-01.college: Lab photo {document} matches a photo already submitted by another institution.
R-IMG-01.next_step: order a site inspection of the lab
R-IMG-01.fix: Submit original photos taken at your own campus.

R-IMG-02.title: Photo taken far from the campus
R-IMG-02.plain: {document} was taken {km} km from the campus.
R-IMG-02.college: Photo {document} was not taken at your campus address.
R-IMG-02.next_step: ask for photos taken on campus through live capture
R-IMG-02.fix: Take photos on your campus; use the live capture link.

R-IMG-03.title: Photo has no camera details
R-IMG-03.next_step: ask for the original camera photo
R-IMG-03.fix: Upload {document} straight from the camera or phone, not a forwarded or edited copy.

R-PDF-01.title: Edited after it was issued
R-PDF-01.plain: {document} was edited after it was issued: {history}.
R-PDF-01.college: Your {document} appears to have been changed after it was issued.
R-PDF-01.next_step: ask the issuer for a fresh copy of the certificate
R-PDF-01.fix: Submit the document exactly as you received it from the issuer.

R-PDF-02.title: A key field uses a different font or size
R-PDF-02.plain: '{field}' on {document} ({shows}) is set in a different font from every other field.
R-PDF-02.college: The '{field}' value on your {document} is set in a different font from the rest of the document.
R-PDF-02.next_step: treat the '{field}' value on the {document} as altered
R-PDF-02.fix: Submit the document exactly as you received it from the issuer.

R-PDF-03.title: White box covering text
R-PDF-03.plain: A white box on {document} hides '{hidden_text}' under the visible '{shows}'.
R-PDF-03.college: Part of your {document} has been covered over.
R-PDF-03.next_step: ask the issuer for the original document
R-PDF-03.fix: Submit the document exactly as you received it from the issuer.

R-IMG-05.title: Tampering hotspot in a scanned image
R-IMG-05.college: Your scanned {document} shows signs of editing.
R-IMG-05.next_step: ask for the original document and check it at inspection
R-IMG-05.fix: Scan the original document again without editing it.

R-CAP-01.title: Live photo taken outside the campus boundary
R-CAP-01.plain: Live photo '{shot}' was taken {outside_m} m outside the campus boundary.
R-CAP-01.college: Live photo '{shot}' was not taken inside your campus boundary.
R-CAP-01.fix: Take every live photo inside your campus.

R-CAP-02.title: One-time code missing or wrong
R-CAP-02.plain: Live photo '{shot}' does not show the one-time code {code}.
R-CAP-02.college: Live photo '{shot}' does not show the one-time code.
R-CAP-02.fix: Hold the card with the one-time code inside every photo.

R-CAP-03.title: Live photo taken outside the time window
R-CAP-03.plain: Live photo '{shot}' was taken {late_min} minutes after the session closed.
R-CAP-03.college: Live photo '{shot}' was taken after the session closed.
R-CAP-03.fix: Take all photos within 30 minutes of opening the link.

R-CAP-04.title: Looks like a photo of a screen or print
R-CAP-04.plain: Live photo '{shot}' looks like a photo of a flat screen or print, not a real room.
R-CAP-04.college: Live photo '{shot}' looks like a photo of a screen or print.
R-CAP-04.fix: Photograph the real room, and step sideways when the app asks.
